name: bugfix-summary
input:
I fixed the crash in the upload handler.

The problem was in `parseHeaders()`: it assumed every header had a value, so an empty `Content-Type` threw a `TypeError`.

**What changed**
- `src/upload.js`: guard against empty header values.
- `test/upload.test.js`: added a regression test for the empty header case.

All 142 tests pass.
